newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - ADRs flat in quiet New York trade.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - ADRs flat in quiet New York trade.

text.p: Foreign shares were flat in quiet New York trade on Monday, with little news to move stocks, as the larger market fell.

Among European stocks, British Sky Broadcasting Group fell 7/8 to 51-3/8 after the London Evening Standard reported major banks were moving away from helping the broadcaster launch digital satellite television.
Latin American shares were sluggish, reflecting profit-taking and a recent shift by emerging market investors into East Asian stocks.
"There is no indication that anyone is hammering the table for Latin American stocks," said Ray Kelly, Latin American director at Robert Fleming. "The turnover here is pathetic."
Brazilian bellwether Telebras rose 1/4 to 76 over expectations for a bill to be introduced in Congress this week. The measure would set rules for opening up the telecommunications sector.
Japanese stocks fell in very light trade following a drop in Tokyo's Nikkei-225 index as a recent boom in blue-chip issues slowed. Honda Motor Co dropped 1-3/4 to 57-5/8.
Decliners led advancers by a margin of 319 against 174. Volume was 27.1 million in late morning.
